main_text.p: ret, passim innuit, non longe ab uno quoq; esse nostrum; Sic enim Rerum Naturalium cap. 4. pag. 56. queritur, filios hominum id non observare, sed potius contemnere, quod Deus in natura abscondituм posuit. In eandem sententiam in fine memorialis suæ tabellæ, vera radix vilis est (inquit) etiam oculis ipsi plebi visibiliter exposita, ignota tamen, & sine multiplici præmonstrata proba homini in caliginoso abdita. Totus enim hic Mundus (quod & Bernhardus testatur) eam videt, nec tamen agnoscit. Sic de Magno Mundi minoris mysterio sub finem pag. 220. Prima materia toti mundo manifesta (inquit) coram oculis sita est, quam paucissimis tamen cognita, & adhæc ubiq; locorum visibiliter reperienda nem NB.

page.notes: The last word "nem" is the catchword-like continuation at the foot of the column and is printed right-aligned; "ubiq;" line ends with a fragmentary word. Left edge of the page shows fragments of the adjacent page, not transcribed. Some words in the italic passages are uncertain at the scan resolution, notably "abscondituм" which may be "absconditum" and should be read as printed.
